newsitem.title: USA: VDI Media cuts estimated IPO price.
newsitem.headline: VDI Media cuts estimated IPO price.

text.p: VDI Media has cut the price for shares to be offered in its initial public offering to $6.50 to $7.50 a share.
The Hollywood, California firm duplicates and distributes broadcast videos such as national television spot advertising, trailers and electronic press kits.

It previously estimated shares would price between $10 and $12 in the 2.8 million share offering. Of the total number of shares, 2.6 million will be sold by the company and the balance to be offered by selling shareholders, according to the company's prospectus.
The offering is tentatively scheduled to price and begin trading next week, according to lead underwriter Prudential Securities.
After the offering, the company's chief executive and cofounder Luke Stefanko will own about 60.4 pct of the company, the company said in its prospectus.
